answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims at reproducing the semantics and topics of the original text in a concise and fluent summary by paraphrasing.

answer_2.quote: ROUGE scores: ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2) and ROUGE-L (R-L) ) by F1. Variance (Var): Variance of the summary lengths against the desired length l

answer_4.quote: We ask three human annotators who are native or proficient English speakers to score the generated summaries under 3 aspects: Grammatically correct (Gram.): How grammatical the sentences of a summary are?; Informativeness (Info.): How much important information about the source document is included in summary?; Overall: How good is the overall quality of the summary on you criterion?
